summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC., a Taiwan-based semiconductor packaging and testing company listed on the TWSE and SEC-registered as a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing the English translation of its September 29, 2026 Taiwan Market Observation Post System disclosure. The filing was triggered because the company's securities reached the TWSE's disclosure threshold for trading information, not by any corporate transaction. It reports August 2026 revenue of NT$2,786 million, up 33.3% year over year, and 2026Q2 revenue of NT$7,383 million, with quarterly profit attributable to parent of NT$892 million and EPS of NT$1.28. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present; this is routine financial-information disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
